text: At TB Tools revision e1ebf2bf42e2d2530ad120fdcc7c5322e87ff4a0, beforeTurn checks up to six retrieved lessons against their recorded revision and scoped paths. A matching Git diff only establishes that those files match; it does not independently verify the lesson. Changed files, unavailable revisions, and missing exact baselines produce notices to recheck the claim. This helps assess applicability before relying on stored knowledge. The snapshot is from the unmerged codex/standalone-knowledge branch; it does not establish default-branch behavior.
title: Source matches do not verify a lesson
